newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton ends weaker ahead of USDA export data.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton ends weaker ahead of USDA export data.

text.p: NYCE cotton ended barely weaker after a mere 6,550 lots changed hands on the day.
Traders blame the lack of interest on expectations for a neutral export and sales report on Thursday, the Independence Day holiday on Friday, and a general lack of fundamental news.
The benchmark contract closed down 0.14 cent at 76.69 cents per lb, traded 76.80 to 76.45 cents. The rest settled 0.05 to 0.35 cent lower.
Resistance in December remained at 77.70 to 77.95 cents, with support at 76.40 to 76.10 cents.
NYCE will be closed Friday in observance of U.S. Independence Day. It will reopen Monday.
